name: Handoff
tagline: Cut mid-project noise down to one task, three steps and an owner
description: Built for the point where a project has too much context and no clear next move. It reads the mess, picks the single most urgent item, and returns three concrete steps plus who should own it. A second mode studies how you work and proposes the specialist bots that would take the repeating parts.
author: thisisclaireli
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
